decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Mystic Forge, Paradox Engine, and Basalt Monolith to generate infinite mana and card advantage to cast powerful spells like Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring. The deck utilizes artifacts like Mox Opal and Mana Key to ramp up quickly and control the board with cards like Defense Grid. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state and game-ending threats.

The main theme of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck focuses on resource management and using cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Force of Will to manipulate the top of the deck and control the tempo of the game. It also includes powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Terminus to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and a way to reset the board state if needed.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly establish a board presence, supported by countermagic like Force of Will and disruptive spells like Wasteland and Stifle. The deck also includes aggressive finishers like Murktide Regent to close out the game. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with early threats and disruption while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing powerful Goblins like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster, along with cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide for fast mana acceleration, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and deal damage to the opponent before they can set up their own strategy. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls help protect the Goblins and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Shatterskull Smashing and Broadside Bombardiers provide additional removal and reach.

The main concept of this Canadian Threshold deck is to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, the deck aims to finish the game quickly and efficiently before the opponent can establish their own game plan. Additionally, card selection tools like Ponder and Brainstorm help ensure consistency in drawing the right cards at the right time.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Dark Depths combo using cards like Sylvan Library, Once Upon a Time, and Green Sun's Zenith to find key pieces. Crop Rotation and Mox Diamond help accelerate the process, while Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer can tutor for necessary lands. The deck also includes protection with cards like Swords to Plowshares, Sylvan Safekeeper, and Ramunap Excavator. With solid land choices and mana ramp, the goal is to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token as quickly as possible to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this Legacy Goblins deck is to swarm the board with aggressive Goblin creatures and use powerful support cards like Chrome Mox and Chalice of the Void to control the game. The deck aims to quickly ramp up its mana using cards like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors, while utilizing cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. The inclusion of Cavern of Souls helps ensure that the Goblins can't be countered, while cards like Shatterskull Smashing provide additional removal options. The deck's aggressive strategy is further supported by cards like Battle Cry Goblin and Broadside Bombardiers, allowing it to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

This Maverick deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Mawloc to apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption in the form of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Green Sun's Zenith and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help tutor for key cards, while mana acceleration from cards like Birds of Paradise and Noble Hierarch allow for explosive plays. The deck also includes hate cards like Collector Ouphe and Outland Liberator to disrupt opponents' strategies. Land destruction with Wasteland adds another layer of disruption to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Troll of Khazad-dûm, then bring them back to the battlefield using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Grief. The deck also utilizes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate big threats while controlling the game with counter magic and disruptive creatures, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, supported by disruptive spells such as Daze, Force of Will, and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells and removal while applying pressure with creatures, aiming to close out the game quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Orcish Bowmasters and Molten Collapse provides additional versatility and ways to deal with various threats from the opponent.

This Dimir Aggro Legacy deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, disruption, and graveyard interaction. By utilizing cards like Grief, Reanimate, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes removal spells such as Fatal Push and Snuff Out to handle threats on the board. With a mix of efficient spells and creatures, this deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible while keeping the opponent on the back foot.

The deck focuses on using a variety of control cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also gaining card advantage and tempo. It includes cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares for removal, along with powerful card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also utilizes Leyline Binding to lock down opposing threats and has strong late-game threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Murktide Regent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes fetch lands to fix mana and thin the deck.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on using cheap and efficient spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent while maintaining a strong aggressive presence with powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes key cards like Brainstorm and Force of Will to dig for answers and protect its threats. By combining disruption, card advantage, and a fast clock, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize and mount a defense.

This BUG Control Legacy deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while efficiently deploying threats like Murktide Regent. It includes a mix of countermagic, removal, and card advantage to control the board and grind out advantage. The deck utilizes a variety of tools such as Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Wasteland to interact with the opponent and protect its own threats. With a focus on controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opposition to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to control the board and protect your threats, while also utilizing powerful graveyard recursion effects like Reanimate and Lórien Revealed to quickly bring back key creatures. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Grief and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm to set up draws and maintain card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes disruptive lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures, backed up by some powerful support cards. By utilizing cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Goblin Rabblemaster, you can quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to your opponent. The inclusion of cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide allows for explosive starts, while cards like Cavern of Souls and City of Traitors help you cast your spells more efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively through aggressive Goblin tribal synergy.
